summary: Google DeepMind's Josh Woodward announced Gemini Spark is expanding to more Ultra subscribers and gaining features: editing Google Docs, reading comments in Sheets and Slides, and a >50% speed improvement.

mechanisms.reason: Broader rollout to more subscribers implies more usage, though the scope is vaguely stated with a footnote qualifier.
mechanisms.quote: Gemini Spark is headed to more Ultra subscribers around the world*

practices.reason: Spark gains document-editing, comment-reading tool use and a stated speed improvement, changing what the assistant can be trusted to do interactively.
practices.quote: Spark can open and edit Google Docs, acting on feedback from last week
